text: 中国证监会国际合作司发布关于苏州东山精密制造股份有限公司境外发行上市备案通知书，公司拟发行不超过234,038,600股境外上市普通股并在香港联合交易所上市。
text_en: The International Cooperation Department of the China Securities Regulatory Commission issued a notice on the overseas issuance and listing filing for Suzhou Dongshan Precision Manufacturing Co., Ltd., which plans to issue no more than 234,038,600 overseas-listed ordinary shares and list on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange.
